主要内容: This report is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, detailing the issuance of various securities, including Trigger Phoenix Autocallable Optimization Securities and Reverse Convertible Notes. The report outlines the details of these securities, such as the pricing date, settlement date, and principal amount. The filing is part of the Bank's shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806). The report also includes legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the securities under Canadian and New York law. The filing was made on January 23, 2012, and is intended to be incorporated by reference into the Bank's registration statement.
